blocks.text: This chapter records a pivotal moment in Israel's history: David proposes to build a permanent temple for God, but the LORD responds with something more consequential. Rather than accepting the building project, God redirects the promise. David will not build a house for God; instead, God will establish a house for David. The LORD promises David an enduring dynasty, an offspring who will build the temple, and a covenant of loyalty that will persist even through discipline. This divine counter-offer transforms the nature of Israel's faith: the promise is now bound to a royal line and a future heir.
